column3: n. 煽动骚乱, 暴动, 妨害治安, 骚动;煽动, 煽动叛逆罪, 暴动
column5: The colonial authorities jailed the editors for publishing what they called sedition.
column6: 殖民当局以煽动叛乱罪监禁了这些编辑。

column3: vi. 混入, 渗入, 掺杂;vt. 使混合
column5: At the trade fair, startups and legacy banks intermingle freely at shared tables.
column6: 在贸易展上，初创公司和老牌银行在共用展台自由交流。

column3: n. (自以为)文化修养高的人, 卖弄知识的人;a. 自炫博学的, 知识分子的, 不切实际的
column5: The festival balances highbrow documentaries with crowd-pleasing summer comedies.
column6: 这个电影节在曲高和寡的纪录片与大众喜剧之间求平衡。

column3: vi. 出风头, 炫耀;n. 出风头, 炫耀, 虚张声势, 优雅
column5: The tech conference moved to a swank hotel downtown this year.
column6: 今年科技大会搬到了市中心一家豪华酒店。

column3: n. 过食, 过度, 恶心;vt. 使厌腻, 使沉溺于
column5: A surfeit of streaming services leaves viewers paralyzed by endless choice.
column6: 流媒体服务泛滥，观众面对无尽选择反而无从下手。

column3: n. 一束, 飞鸟群, 纠纷;染色质纽, 丝球; 线团, 线球
column5: A gray skein of geese crossed the cold November sky at dusk.
column6: 黄昏时，一队斜排成线的灰雁掠过十一月的寒空。

column3: n. 不透明, 电波不透过, 不透明体;浑浊, 不透明, 不透光, 不透明区, 浊斑
column5: Regulators demanded less opacity and clearer disclosure in the fund's quarterly reports.
column6: 监管机构要求基金季报减少不透明，披露更清晰。

column3: n. 提升, 提高, 得意洋洋;兴奋, 激越
column5: The soprano's final note carried an exaltation that silenced the hall.
column6: 女高音的最后一个音符带着令人屏息的激越，全场为之静默。

column3: n. 占卜官, 预言者;v. 预示, 预言
column5: The falling export numbers augur a difficult autumn for the manufacturing sector.
column6: 出口数据下滑预示制造业将迎来艰难的秋天。

column3: n. 亵渎圣物, 冒渎, 渎圣行为;橇门入教堂行窃, 窃取圣物
column5: Locals considered painting over the mural a sacrilege against the town's history.
column6: 当地人认为覆盖那幅壁画是对小镇历史的亵渎。

column3: a. 放荡的, 不检点的, 浪费的;n. 放荡者, 享乐者
column5: The board ousted the profligate CEO after two years of lavish spending.
column6: 挥霍无度的总裁在两年奢靡支出后被董事会罢免。

column3: n. 孔口;口, 管口
column5: The engineer measured airflow through each small orifice in the tunnel wall.
column6: 工程师测量隧道壁每个小孔的气流。

column3: vt. 提供错误消息
column5: Pages that misinform voters will lose advertising under the new policy.
column6: 按新政策，误导选民的内容将被停投广告。

column3: n. 吊秋千
column5: The circus recruit practiced on the trapeze until her hands blistered.
column6: 杂技新学员练吊杠练到双手起泡。

column3: a. 迷人的
column5: The documentary's enthralling footage of the deep sea kept students utterly silent.
column6: 纪录片摄人心魄的深海画面让学生们全神贯注。

column3: a. 晒热的, 酷热的, 炎热的
column5: The team survived a torrid August schedule of nine away matches.
column6: 球队熬过了八月连续九个客场的酷热赛程。

column3: a. 年轻而无经验的, (鸟)羽毛未丰的;无羽毛的
column5: The callow intern assumed the veterans would accept his plan without question.
column6: 幼稚的实习生以为老员工会毫无异议地接受他的方案。

column3: a. 子女的, 当做子女的, 孝顺的;子女的
column5: Filial duty kept the young doctor close to her ailing parents.
column6: 出于子女的责任，年轻医生守在年迈患病的父母身边。

column3: n. 下倾, 倾斜, 衰微;偏角, 偏差, 偏转(眼球)
column5: The compass showed a declination of eight degrees between magnetic and true north.
column6: 罗盘显示磁北与正北之间存在八度偏角。

column3: n. 流浪者, 浪子, 流氓;vi. 到处流浪
column5: The old vagabond traded stories for meals in every town along the river.
column6: 老流浪汉沿河在各个镇上用讲故事换饭吃。

column3: n. 逃避现实, 逃避主义
column5: Critics defend fantasy fiction as more than mere escapism for tired readers.
column6: 评论家为奇幻小说辩护，认为它不只是疲惫读者的逃避。

column3: vt. 供俗用, 亵渎, 轻蔑地对待
column5: Soldiers were prosecuted for trying to desecrate the ancient temple complex.
column6: 士兵因企图亵渎古庙建筑群而被起诉。

column3: a. 不讲道德的, 不正直的
column5: The audit revealed an unprincipled scheme to overcharge rural customers systematically.
column6: 审计揭露了系统性多收乡村客户费用的无良骗局。

column3: n. 代用品
column5: The diner's ersatz maple syrup was mostly corn syrup with brown coloring.
column6: 这家餐馆的人造枫糖浆主要是掺了色素的玉米糖浆。

column3: vt. 以陷阱捕捉, 诱入圈套, 诱捕
column5: Fraudsters ensnare victims with fake job ads promising unusually high salaries.
column6: 骗子用许诺高薪的假招聘广告诱人上钩。

column3: n. 小蜘蛛网, 蛛丝, 薄纱;a. 薄弱的, 轻飘飘的
column5: A gossamer layer of fog hovered over the fields at sunrise.
column6: 日出时，一层薄雾轻笼田野。

column3: a. 伪的, 不足凭信的
column5: The story about the CEO's garage startup is probably apocryphal, journalists found.
column6: 记者发现，总裁车库创业的传闻很可能不足凭信。

column3: n. 雕像, 雕像艺术, 雕像家;a. 雕像的, 雕像用的
column5: The gallery's statuary collection spans two millennia of Mediterranean stone carving.
column6: 美术馆的雕像收藏跨越两千年地中海石雕史。

column3: vt. 撤消遣散, 复员, 使无效, 使不活动
column5: Please deactivate the alarm before opening the laboratory door each morning.
column6: 每天早上开实验室门前请先解除警报。

column3: n. 牧人, 牧主
column5: The herdsman moves his goats to higher pastures every June.
column6: 牧人每年六月把羊群赶到更高的牧场。
